messages:
Ava Lim: heads-up: i'm going to do a compact rewrite of the Hello Docker quickstart to be <5mins read. remove old long-run sections, add ephemeral key flow, and a minimal Dockerfile + CI smoke test. will open PR in 20m. need eng-runtime glance.

Ravi Kapoor: please keep the 'run locally' instructions. some users skip Docker and go straight to node. also include the legacy token one-liner in a shielded note.

Ava Lim: yep keeping local run.

Omar Haddad: if you include streaming, add the note: "streaming requires websocket-compatible handler". also confirm `model` naming.

Ava Lim: good point. will use `model` and non-streaming by default.

lighthouse-bot: Lighthouse check queued for PR #1518.

Ava Lim: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1518  reviewers: @Ravi Kapoor @Omar Haddad.

Ravi Kapoor: reviewing. small edit: change ENV name to RW_API_KEY to match other docs.

Omar Haddad: approved after nit about handler name in the streaming example.

Ava Lim: merged. will post short changelog line in the quickstart index. :sparkles:
